request.query: cardinality box finitely supported natural multi indices bounded r product r plus one

items.name: DFinsupp.card_pi
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → Zero (α i)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)] (f : Π₀ (i : ι), Finset (α i)), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card

items.name: DFinsupp.card_Iic
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (α i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → PartialOrder (α i)]
  [inst_4 : ∀ (i : ι), CanonicallyOrderedAdd (α i)] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → OrderBot (α i)]
  [inst_6 : (i : ι) → LocallyFiniteOrder (α i)] (f : Π₀ (i : ι), α i),
  (Finset.Iic f).card = ∏ i ∈ f.support, (Finset.Iic (f i)).card

items.name: Finsupp.card_pi
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] (f : ι →₀ Finset α), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_nat
items.type: ∀ (α : Type u) [Nonempty α], Cardinal.mk (α →₀ ℕ) = max (Cardinal.mk α) Cardinal.aleph0

items.name: Finset.card_dfinsupp
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Zero (α i)] (s : Finset ι)
  (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)), (s.dfinsupp t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card

items.name: Finsupp.card_Icc
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : PartialOrder α] [inst_1 : Zero α] [inst_2 : LocallyFiniteOrder α]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq α] (f g : ι →₀ α),
  (Finset.Icc f g).card = ∏ i ∈ f.support ∪ g.support, (Finset.Icc (f i) (g i)).card

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_lift_of_fintype
items.type:
∀ (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Zero β],
  Cardinal.mk (α →₀ β) = Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk β) ^ Fintype.card α

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_of_fintype
items.type: ∀ (α β : Type u) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Zero β], Cardinal.mk (α →₀ β) = Cardinal.mk β ^ Fintype.card α
